column3: Project and Space split in xin.workspace v2: projects keep slug, name, preset, settings and archived; spaces own name, goal, projectId, coordinatorId and threadIds; threads gain optional spaceId
column4: Keyur asked for Amp's Project/Space/Puck shape with one owner, no members and no sharing; keeping the Space on the Project would make every later step a migration
column5: WorkspaceDoc v2 migrate (one space per v1 project) with a fixture test; scope resolves puck/space/thread; gate fmt, lint, types, test and bundle green
column6: accepted; goal is stored on the Space but not injected yet, and project-less Spaces are not allowed until a use case needs them
